gen-irish-grover-gf-suwannaphum: Fun and organic, Irish Grover stands tall with sturdy, oversized-looking words and softly varied strokes. Suwannaphum does the dignified, editorial work, with a high squared-off x-height and a c as open as a bent paperclip.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-hanuman: Loud and cheerful, Luckiest Guy looks poured at a single width. Hanuman sits underneath with a high-waisted, refined lowercase, so the shouting up top lands on something traditional and settled.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noticia-text: Luckiest Guy is cheerful and loud, with a high mean line and ink that looks poured at one width. Noticia Text brings the literary dignity, with big curved entrances.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-scope-one: Traditional and refined, the body text lets its counters spill into open space beneath the loud monoline of Luckiest Guy. Scope One adds stubby ascenders and a big x-height, which feel sturdy beside that cheerful shout.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-suwannaphum: Cheerful and loud: Luckiest Guy, with its high mean line. Suwannaphum feels dignified and editorial beside it, its high squared-off x-height like a woodblock letter holding the shout in check.
gen-megrim-gf-slabo-13px: Megrim is angular and futuristic, with every stroke ending at the same measured thickness and a skyward x-height line. Slabo 13px brings bookish dignity and large, clearly open counters.
gen-nixie-one-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Retro-tech and nostalgic, Nixie One draws every curve with one constant stroke. BhuTuka Expanded One is the standout, literary and authoritative, its curvy letters slowing the pace to a leisurely walk.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-epunda-slab: Cut-out letters pinned far apart: that is Press Start 2P, fun and retro, with modulation you only spot up close. Epunda Slab then settles things with dignified, tall rounded lowercase and a visibly gaping c.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-glegoo: Press Start 2P is fun and retro, spaced like cut-outs pinned far apart. The heading font is best at softly inked, hand-drawn character, while Glegoo is best at refined, editorial text with big counters and open-mouthed curves.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-scope-one: Fun and retro, Press Start 2P keeps its contrast subdued across the alphabet, with big open-looking bowls. Scope One steps in with traditional, refined text and a big x-height, so the playful top line meets something steadier.
